info.title: india-subscriptions HTTP API
info.description: One API over subscriptions on Indian payment gateways (Razorpay, Cashfree, PayU). Amounts are integer paise and instants are ISO-8601 strings.

post.description: For apps that receive the gateway webhook themselves: forward the exact raw body and the headers here. The signature is verified and the events are returned normalised. A bad signature answers 401.

post.description: The URL to register at the gateway. It takes no API key because gateways cannot send one: the request is authenticated by the gateway's signature over the exact raw body. A bad signature answers 401. If the service's event hook fails the answer is 500, so the gateway retries.
